discovery_provenance.method: exploratory finite candidate search followed by complete deterministic enumeration

parent_formula.criticality_certificate: The full eight-clause formula is the unique clause subset of deficiency 2; every proper clause subset has deficiency at most 1.

siblings.branchwise_rank_effect: parent 2 -> siblings 1 and 0; both are strict descendants and both are SAT

literal_substitution_exhaustion.definition: A map phi sends every target variable to any signed source literal, repetitions allowed, with phi(-v)=-phi(v). It is a valid R44BS transport iff every target clause image is tautological or contains a source clause as a subset.

meaning: R44BS strictly extends signed permutations and succeeds on the R44BR no-permutation pair.
R44BT proves unrestricted generic discovery of R44BS substitutions is NP-complete.
R44BU gives polynomial fixed-K discovery on a nontrivial infinite family.
R44BV proves no fixed K is universally complete on critical siblings.
R44BW now proves the full signed-literal substitution relation itself is not universally applicable on maxdef-critical sibling pairs.

next_exact_question: Move exactly one relation class broader than literal substitutions. A natural candidate is affine Boolean model transport, where each target variable is an affine GF(2) function of a bounded number of source variables and every target clause is certified as implied by the source CNF under that map. Either construct a polynomially verifiable safe deletion on R44BW or prove an exact obstruction for one fixed affine subclass.
